title: UAAP: UE says Gavina to ‘pursue new opportunities’ as Hubalde officially named acting coach
summary: University of the East officially announced Paulo Hubalde as the acting head coach of the UE Red Warriors, saying ex-mentor Chris Gavina has opted to “pursue” new opportunities.
